items.claim: The assault lift for Dragoon loaded at Naples and Salerno while French formations came round from Oran; exclusive of naval crews the convoys carried about 151,000 troops and vehicles across to the Riviera assault area, then west to Toulon (15–28 August 1944) and Marseille (21–28 August).

sources.quote: the convoys carried roughly 151,000 troops and some 21,400 trucks, tanks, tank destroyers, prime-movers, bulldozers, tractors, and other vehicles. Included in these totals were about 40,850 men and 2,610 vehicles of the First French Army that were to start unloading on D plus 1.
